en_title: James Gunn Defends the DCU's Approach to Interconnected Stories, Doesn't Want Movies Like Clayface to Exist Just to 'Set Up' Crossovers
cn_title: 古恩：DCU单片不应只为联动铺路
subtitle: 先讲好自己的故事
opus_summary: 詹姆斯·古恩表示，DCU作品不必只为后续联动铺路，独立故事本身也应具备意义。他希望观众因为《泥面》是一部精彩的恐怖片而观看，而不是只关注角色未来会否登场。

paragraphs.en: DC Studios co-chairman James Gunn has defended the DCU's approach to interconnected stories, saying he doesn't want movies like Clayface to exist just to "set up" crossovers.
paragraphs.cn: DC Studios联合主席James Gunn为DCU的故事联动方式辩护。他表示，自己不希望《泥面》这样的电影存在的目的，只是为后续联动「铺路」。

paragraphs.en: Clayface poured into the DCU when it brought the tragic story of Matt Hagen (Tom Rhys Harries) to theaters yesterday. A bloody body horror movie with a firm R rating, its October release date makes sense as it molded its way into the comic book movie universe with a more adult story, but not everyone is happy with the film's place in the universe.
paragraphs.cn: 随着《泥面》于昨日将Matt Hagen（Tom Rhys Harries）的悲剧故事搬上大银幕，这部电影也正式融入了DCU。作为一部血腥的身体恐怖片，《泥面》明确为R级，10月上映也很合适，因为它以更加成人化的故事进入了超级英雄电影宇宙。不过，并不是所有人都满意这部电影在DCU中的定位。

paragraphs.en: Despite solid scores from critics and fans (IGN gave it a 7/10 review ), there are DC watchers who have continued to complain that executives like Gunn and co-chairman Peter Safran haven't done a good job of using smaller stories to build toward bigger tie-in projects. For reference, the DCU technically started with animated series Creature Commandos before heading to theaters with Superman . Peacemaker Season 2, Supergirl , Lanterns , and Clayface then followed.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管《泥面》获得了影评人和粉丝的不错评价，IGN也给出了7/10分，但仍有一些DC关注者持续抱怨，认为古恩和联合主席Peter Safran等高管没有很好地利用规模较小的故事，为更大型的联动项目铺路。严格来说，DCU是从动画剧集《Creature Commandos》开始的，随后才通过《超人》进军影院。之后，《和平使者》第2季、《超级少女》、《Lanterns》和《泥面》相继推出。

paragraphs.en: While standalone Wonder Woman and Batman movies are in the cards, projects like The People v. Gorilla Grodd seem to be further along than most, with crossover moments mostly limited so far. So, what gives? Gunn has an easy answer that might leave impatient fans wanting more, but for him, it's a solution that will keep the DCU telling quality stories for years to come.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然独立的《神奇女侠》和《新蝙蝠侠》电影已经在计划之中，但目前看来，《The People v. Gorilla Grodd》等项目的进展似乎比大多数作品更快，而截至目前，作品之间的联动时刻仍然十分有限。究竟是怎么回事？古恩给出了一个简单的答案，或许会让缺乏耐心的粉丝觉得意犹未尽，但在他看来，这种做法能够让DCU在未来多年持续讲述高质量故事。

paragraphs.en: "I couldn't agree more," he said when replying to a fan defending the cinematic universe on Threads. "DCU is just an alternate universe; we can enter at any location or time and tell THAT story. I dislike the idea that individual stories aren't meaningful unless they lead to something else."
paragraphs.cn: 在Threads上回复一名为这一电影宇宙辩护的粉丝时，古恩说道：「我完全同意。DCU只是一个平行宇宙；我们可以从任何地点或时间切入，讲述那个故事。我不喜欢这样一种观念：除非某个独立故事通向其他内容，否则它就没有意义。」

paragraphs.en: Gunn continued, saying it's "strange" to see "people not understanding this" considering Star Wars has taken a similar approach for decades. He did admit Disney's sci-fi franchise may not have the "tonal variety" of something like the DCU , which has so far ping-ponged between serious drama and action to comedy and, most recently, horror. Still, he wants fans to know that, no matter how different each movie or show may be, there is still connective tissue holding them together.
paragraphs.cn: 古恩继续表示，考虑到《星球大战》几十年来一直采用类似的方式，看到「有人无法理解这一点」实在很「奇怪」。不过他也承认，迪士尼旗下的科幻系列可能没有DCU那样丰富的「风格变化」。截至目前，DCU的作品在严肃剧情、动作、喜剧以及最近的恐怖题材之间来回切换。即便如此，古恩仍希望粉丝知道，无论每部电影或剧集的风格有多么不同，它们之间始终存在将彼此联系起来的纽带。

paragraphs.en: "The Superman Saga starts with Superman and travels into Man of Tomorrow and onward, and contains many characters we've introduced in other stories," he continued in a follow-up post . "But that doesn't mean those other stories only exist to set up what's happening there. I would love people to be seeing Clayface because it's a great, fun horror movie unto itself, not because of where else Clayface will show up three movies from now."
paragraphs.cn: 古恩在后续帖文中继续说道：「《超人传奇》从《超人》开始，延续至《Man of Tomorrow》以及后续作品，其中包含许多我们在其他故事中介绍过的角色。但这并不意味着，那些其他故事存在的唯一目的，就是为这里发生的事情铺路。我希望人们观看《泥面》，是因为它本身就是一部精彩而有趣的恐怖片，而不是因为他们想知道《泥面》这个角色三部电影之后还会在哪部作品中登场。」

paragraphs.en: While not everyone is pleased that DC Studios doesn't want to dive head first into crossover event films, one of the reasons others have actually been excited for Clayface is its promise to weave its way into the universe with a new Gotham City. We won't talk about whether Batman or Bruce Wayne make any appearances here , but with plenty of footage taking viewers through one of DC's most iconic locations, it's clear Gunn and co. are more interested in continuing to lay a worthy foundation rather than speeding into a big team-up movie like the Justice League .
paragraphs.cn: 虽然并不是所有人都满意DC Studios不愿一头扎进联动事件电影，但另一些人之所以对《泥面》感到兴奋，恰恰是因为影片承诺将通过全新的哥谭市融入这个宇宙。我们不会讨论蝙蝠侠或Bruce Wayne是否会在片中登场，但从大量带领观众探索DC最具代表性地点之一的画面来看，古恩及其团队显然更希望继续打下扎实的基础，而不是急着推出类似《正义联盟》的大型合作电影。

paragraphs.en: Gunn took his time on social media today to touch base on a few other projects in the works. Creature Commandos Season 2, for example , will arrive after Man of Tomorrow's premiere next year. Speaking of the Superman sequel, a small group of people has now seen director's cuts of the film , with Gunn calling the process "exciting" as he tries "to recut over the week and screen the latest version for a few new eyes every Friday."
paragraphs.cn: 古恩今天还在社交媒体上抽出时间，谈到了几部正在制作中的其他项目。比如，《Creature Commandos》第2季将在《Man of Tomorrow》明年上映后推出。谈到《超人》的续作时，古恩透露，目前已经有一小群人看过这部电影的导演剪辑版。他称这一过程「令人兴奋」，并表示自己会「在一周内重新剪辑，然后每周五让几位新观众观看最新版本」。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Elseworlds sequel, The Batman Part 2 , is still seemingly on track for its February 18, 2028, release date despite recent behind-the-scenes shuffling . For an update on the status of the DCU's Batman, you can click here . Finally, for everything else in the DC movie pipeline, we've got you covered here .
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，作为Elseworlds系列续作的《新蝙蝠侠2》，尽管近期幕后团队出现调整，但目前看来仍将按计划于2028年2月18日上映。关于DCU中蝙蝠侠项目的最新进展，请点击这里。至于DC电影制作计划中的其他内容，请点击这里了解详情。
